Meghalaya CM Reaffirms Opposition to Uranium Mining in State

Meghalaya Chief Minister Conrad K. Sangma has reiterated the state's stance against uranium mining. The decision comes amid discussions about potential mining in the Domiasiat region, which contains low-depth sandstone deposits. Concerns have been raised about the environmental impact, particularly if open-cast mining methods were to be employed.
